def need(value, message):
    if not value:
        raise ValueError(message)


def path(value):
    value = Path(value)
    return value.resolve() if value.is_absolute() else (REPO / value).resolve()


def read(value):
    value = path(value)
    data = value.read_bytes()
    sha = hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
    need(value not in SEEN or SEEN[value] == sha, "Evidence changed: " + str(value))
    SEEN[value] = sha
    return data


def sha(value):
    read(value)
    return SEEN[path(value)]


def text(value):
    data = read(value)
    return data.decode("utf-16" if data.startswith((b"\xff\xfe", b"\xfe\xff")) else "utf-8-sig")


def load(value):
    return json.loads(text(value))


def rel(value):
    value = path(value)
    return value.relative_to(REPO).as_posix() if value.is_relative_to(REPO) else str(value)


def portable(value):
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return {rel(k) if Path(k).is_absolute() else k: portable(v) for k, v in value.items()}
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return [portable(v) for v in value]
    return rel(value) if isinstance(value, str) and Path(value).is_absolute() else value


def identity(value, include=False):
    result = {"path": rel(value), "sha256": sha(value)}
    if include:
        result["content"] = text(value)
    return result


def git(*arguments):
    return subprocess.check_output(["git", "--no-replace-objects", *arguments], cwd=REPO)


def source(directory, expected, revision=None):
    actual = {p.name: sha(p) for p in directory.glob("*.e")}
    need(actual == expected, "Source byte hashes differ: " + str(directory))
    verification = {}
    if revision:
        for name, digest in actual.items():
            blob = git("show", revision + ":src/" + name)
            current = read(directory / name)
            need(blob.replace(b"\r\n", b"\n") == current.replace(b"\r\n", b"\n"),
                 "Source content differs from claimed commit: " + name)
            verification[name] = {"snapshot_sha256": digest, "git_blob_sha256": hashlib.sha256(blob).hexdigest(),
                                  "relation": "byte-identical" if blob == current else "CRLF/LF differences only"}
    return verification

def near(a, b):
    return math.isclose(a, b, rel_tol=1e-10, abs_tol=1e-8)


def compare(name, a, b, pairs, warmups, minimum, categories):
    folder = HERE / name
    data = load(folder / "comparison.json")
    meta = data["metadata"]
    need((meta["pairs"], meta["warmups"], meta["min_sample_seconds"]) == (pairs, warmups, minimum),
         "Unexpected comparison policy: " + name)
    for letter, exe in [("A", a), ("B", b)]:
        need(path(meta["executables"][letter]["path"]) == exe.resolve(), "Wrong measured binary path")
        need(meta["executables"][letter]["sha256"] == sha(exe), "Measured binary changed")
    works = {w["name"]: w for w in meta["workloads"]}
    names = {"pubmed26n1380-first-records-512k.xml": "pubmed", "amp-text.xml": "amp-text",
             "xmlns-mandarin-stylesheet.xsl": "unicode", "DT-Legislation.xml": "legislation"}
    chosen = {key if key in {"catalog", "text", "attributes"} else names.get(Path(item["path"]).name)
              for key, item in works.items()}
    need(chosen == categories and len(works) == len(categories), "Wrong workload selection: " + name)
    for work in works.values():
        if work["path"]:
            need(sha(work["path"]) == work["sha256"], "Measured input changed")
            need(len(read(work["path"])) == work["document_bytes"], "Measured input length changed")
    calibration = {r["Workload"]: r for r in data["calibration"]}
    need(set(calibration) == set(works) and all(min(r["BaselineElapsedMs"], r["CandidateElapsedMs"]) >= minimum * 1000
                                              for r in calibration.values()), "Calibration incomplete")
    raw = data["results"]
    table = list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(text(folder / "comparison.tsv")), delimiter="\t"))
    need(len(raw) == len(table) == pairs * len(works), "Raw pairs incomplete")
    for row, saved in zip(raw, table):
        need(all(str(value) == saved[key] for key, value in row.items()), "Raw JSON/TSV disagree")
        need(row["Workload"] in works and row["Iterations"] > 0 and row["DocumentBytes"] == works[row["Workload"]]["document_bytes"],
             "Raw pair input mismatch")
        for key in ["BaselineElapsedMs", "CandidateElapsedMs", "BaselineMiBPerSecond", "CandidateMiBPerSecond", "CandidateSpeedRatio"]:
            need(math.isfinite(row[key]) and row[key] > 0, "Invalid raw measurement")
        need(near(row["CandidateSpeedRatio"], row["BaselineElapsedMs"] / row["CandidateElapsedMs"]), "Wrong pair ratio")
    need(len(data["summary"]) == len(works) and {s["workload"] for s in data["summary"]} == set(works), "Missing summary")
    for summary in data["summary"]:
        group = [r for r in raw if r["Workload"] == summary["workload"]]
        need([r["Pair"] for r in group] == list(range(1, pairs + 1)), "Missing pair index")
        need([r["Order"] for r in group] == ["AB" if i % 2 else "BA" for i in range(1, pairs + 1)], "Wrong AB/BA order")
        need(len({r["Iterations"] for r in group}) == 1, "Different paired iteration counts")
        ratios = [r["CandidateSpeedRatio"] for r in group]
        need(near(summary["median_candidate_speed_ratio"], statistics.median(ratios)), "Wrong paired median")
        need(near(summary["min_candidate_speed_ratio"], min(ratios)) and near(summary["max_candidate_speed_ratio"], max(ratios)),
             "Outlier range mismatch")
    return {"report": portable(data), "report_identity": identity(folder / "comparison.json"),
            "raw_tsv_identity": identity(folder / "comparison.tsv"),
            "scope": "{} sequential AB/BA pairs, {} warmups, both calibration samples at least {} seconds. "
                     "All pairs and outliers retained; whole-process time includes startup, once initialization, "
                     "raw file preparation, parser reset/reuse and actual internal GC policy.".format(pairs, warmups, minimum)}, read(folder / "comparison.tsv")

    need(result["iterations"] == 8, "Wrong profile iteration count")
    need(sha(result["command"][0]) == result["executable_sha256"], "Profile executable changed")

    folder = HERE / "profiles" / role
    need(text(folder / "stdout.txt").strip() == "xpact benchmark harness parsed 8 documents.", "Profile parse did not complete")
    parsed = []
    for line in text(folder / "profinfo").splitlines():

        if len(fields) >= 6 and fields[0].startswith("["):

    saved = [(r["function"], r["calls"], r["inclusive_seconds"], r["descendants_seconds"]) for r in result["rows"]]

def publish(outputs):
    staged, published = [], []
    try:
        for destination, payload in outputs:
            if destination.exists():
                need(destination.read_bytes() == payload, "Preserving existing different evidence: " + str(destination))
                continue
            descriptor, temporary = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=".pubmed-character-data-", dir=destination.parent)
            with os.fdopen(descriptor, "wb") as stream:
                stream.write(payload)
                stream.flush()
                os.fsync(stream.fileno())
            staged.append((Path(temporary), destination, hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()))
        for temporary, destination, digest in staged:
            need(not destination.exists(), "Publication target appeared concurrently")
            temporary.replace(destination)
            published.append((destination, digest))
    except BaseException:
        for destination, digest in reversed(published):
            if destination.exists() and hashlib.sha256(destination.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == digest:
                destination.unlink()
        raise
    finally:
        for temporary, _, _ in staged:
            temporary.unlink(missing_ok=True)

def capturing_run(*args, **kwargs):
    try:
        completed = ORIGINAL_RUN(*args, **kwargs)
        OBSERVATIONS.process = {"returncode": completed.returncode,
                                "stdout": completed.stdout or b"",
                                "stderr": completed.stderr or b""}
        return completed
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as error:
        OBSERVATIONS.process = {"returncode": None, "stdout": error.stdout or b"",
                                "stderr": error.stderr or b"", "timeout": True}
        raise
    except OSError as error:
        OBSERVATIONS.process = {"returncode": None, "stdout": b"", "stderr": b"",

        "valid-non-ascii-name": ("<é/>".encode("utf-8"), "ACCEPT"),
        "valid-middle-dot-continuation": ("<a·b/>".encode("utf-8"), "ACCEPT"),
        "valid-greek-upper-boundary": ("<\u037f/>".encode("utf-8"), "ACCEPT"),
        "valid-name-upper-plane": ("<\U000effff/>".encode("utf-8"), "ACCEPT"),
        "valid-unicode-text": ("<root>é\U0001f642</root>".encode("utf-8"), "ACCEPT"),
        "invalid-name-digit-start": (b"<1root/>", "REJECT"),
        "invalid-name-combining-start": ("<\u0301root/>".encode("utf-8"), "REJECT"),
        "invalid-name-middle-dot-start": ("<\u00b7root/>".encode("utf-8"), "REJECT"),
        "invalid-name-greek-hole": ("<\u037e/>".encode("utf-8"), "REJECT"),
        "invalid-name-past-upper-plane": ("<\U000f0000/>".encode("utf-8"), "REJECT"),
        "invalid-name-forbidden-fffe": ("<\ufffe/>".encode("utf-8"), "REJECT"),
        "invalid-nul-text": (b"<root>\x00</root>", "REJECT"),
        "invalid-control-attribute": (b'<root a="\x1f"/>', "REJECT"),
    }

        "past-unicode-max": b"\xf4\x90\x80\x80", "invalid-continuation": b"\xc2x",
        "truncated-two": b"\xc2", "truncated-three": b"\xe2\x82",

    }

    for name, (content, expected) in documents.items():
        path = fixtures / (name + ".xml")
        path.write_bytes(content)
        cases.append(W3C.Case("directed:" + name, path,
                              "valid" if expected == "ACCEPT" else "not-wf", False, expected))
    return cases


def observe(case, build, role, executable, timeout, work, known):
    OBSERVATIONS.process = {"returncode": None, "stdout": b"", "stderr": b""}
    row = W3C.run_case(case, role + "-" + build, executable, timeout, work)
    process = OBSERVATIONS.process
    entry = known.get((build, case.id))
    category = ""
    if row.status in {"failed", "error"}:
        category = (entry["category"] if entry and entry["status"] == row.status
                    else W3C.observed_category(row))
    result = asdict(row)
    result.update(returncode=process["returncode"], category=category,
                  listed_baseline_failure=bool(entry and entry["status"] == row.status),
                  stdout_sha256=hashlib.sha256(process["stdout"]).hexdigest(),
                  stderr_sha256=hashlib.sha256(process["stderr"]).hexdigest(),
                  stdout=process["stdout"].decode("utf-8", errors="replace"),
                  stderr=process["stderr"].decode("utf-8", errors="replace"),
                  stdout_hex=process["stdout"].hex(), stderr_hex=process["stderr"].hex())
    return result


def fingerprint(row):
    return tuple(row[key] for key in ("actual", "status", "category", "returncode"))


def compare_one(case, dataset, build, paths, timeout, work, known):
    # Each case and engine has its own crash-output directory, including in parallel runs.
    case_work = work / hashlib.sha256((dataset + case.id).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:20]
    case_work.mkdir()
    observed = {}
    for role, executable in paths.items():
        role_work = case_work / role
        role_work.mkdir()
        observed[role] = observe(case, build, role, executable, timeout, role_work, known)
    baseline, candidate = observed["baseline"], observed["candidate"]
    outcome_match = fingerprint(baseline) == fingerprint(candidate)
    stdout_match = baseline["stdout_hex"] == candidate["stdout_hex"]
    return {"dataset": dataset, "build": build, "case_id": case.id, "path": str(case.path),
            "outcome_match": outcome_match, "stdout_match": stdout_match,
            "match": outcome_match and (dataset != "directed" or stdout_match), **observed}


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--candidate", choices=("candidate",), default="candidate")
    parser.add_argument("--scope", choices=("prepare", "directed", "w3c", "all"), default="prepare",
                        help="Explicitly select execution only after the parent gives the functional-test go")
    parser.add_argument("--existing-only", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--build", action="append", choices=("Finalized", "FinalizedAssertions"))
    parser.add_argument("--timeout", type=float, default=10.0)
    parser.add_argument("--jobs", type=int, default=4)
    parser.add_argument("--suite-dir", type=Path, default=ROOT / "build/validation-corpora/w3c-xml-20130923/xmlconf")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    if args.timeout <= 0 or args.jobs <= 0:
        parser.error("timeout and jobs must be positive")
    output = HERE / ("differential-" + args.candidate)
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    builds = args.build or ["Finalized", "FinalizedAssertions"]
    directed = directed_cases(args.existing_only)
    catalog = W3C.load_catalog(args.suite_dir)
    datasets = {"directed": directed, "w3c": catalog}
    print(json.dumps({"candidate": args.candidate, "scope": args.scope,
                      "directed_cases": len(directed), "catalog_cases": len(catalog),
                      "catalog_applicable": sum(not case.skip_reason for case in catalog)}, indent=2), flush=True)
    if args.scope == "prepare":
        return 0
    selected = datasets if args.scope == "all" else {args.scope: datasets[args.scope]}
    known = W3C.load_known_failures(ROOT / "benchmarks/w3c-known-failures.tsv")
    all_results, summaries = [], []
    # Install a thread-local observer around the unchanged, imported classification helper.
    W3C.subprocess.run = capturing_run
    try:
        for build in builds:
            paths = executables(args.candidate, build)
            metadata = {role: {"path": str(path), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
                        for role, path in paths.items()}
            with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix=build + "-work-", dir=output) as work_name:
                for dataset, cases in selected.items():
                    print("Comparing {} {}: {} cases".format(build, dataset, len(cases)), flush=True)
                    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=args.jobs) as pool:
                        results = list(pool.map(lambda case: compare_one(case, dataset, build, paths,
                                                                         args.timeout, Path(work_name), known), cases))
                    counts = Counter(row["baseline"]["status"] for row in results)
                    skipped = counts["skipped"]
                    differences = [row for row in results if not row["match"]]
                    summary = {"build": build, "dataset": dataset, "total": len(results),
                               "executed": len(results) - skipped, "skipped": skipped,
                               "matches": sum(row["match"] and row["baseline"]["status"] != "skipped" for row in results),
                               "all_case_matches": sum(row["match"] for row in results), "differences": len(differences),
                               "baseline_passed": counts["passed"], "baseline_failed": counts["failed"],
                               "baseline_errors": counts["error"],
                               "baseline_failure_categories": dict(Counter(row["baseline"]["category"] for row in results
                                                                           if row["baseline"]["status"] in {"failed", "error"})),
                               "diagnostic_only_differences": sum(row["outcome_match"] and not row["stdout_match"] for row in results),
                               "executables": metadata}
                    all_results.extend(results)
                    summaries.append(summary)
                    dump(output / "summary.json", {"candidate": args.candidate, "profile": W3C.PROFILE,
                                                   "interpretation": "Unchanged outcomes, not a claim of full conformance; baseline gaps are retained.",
                                                   "engines": summaries})
                    dump(output / "differences.json", [row for row in all_results if not row["match"]])
                    dump(output / "baseline-failures.json", [row for row in all_results
                                                            if row["baseline"]["status"] in {"failed", "error"}])
                    dump(output / "results.json", all_results)
                    print(json.dumps(summary), flush=True)
    finally:
        W3C.subprocess.run = ORIGINAL_RUN
    return int(any(not row["match"] for row in all_results))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

		local
			l_backend: DC_BACKEND
			i: INTEGER
			l_ok: BOOLEAN
		do

			from i := 0; l_ok := True until i = a_iterations or not l_ok loop
				l_ok := l_backend.parse (a_document)

				l_backend.close

			end
		end

	raw_file_bytes (a_path: READABLE_STRING_GENERAL): detachable STRING_8
			-- Read original bytes once; preserve BOMs, encodings and line endings.
		local
			l_file: RAW_FILE
			l_expected_count: INTEGER
		do
			create l_file.make_with_name (a_path)
			if l_file.exists and then l_file.is_plain and then l_file.is_readable then

				l_expected_count := l_file.count
				create Result.make (l_expected_count)

					Result.append (l_file.last_string)

			end
		rescue

			exit_with_code (2)
		end

		local
			l_exceptions: EXCEPTIONS
		do
			create l_exceptions
			l_exceptions.die (a_code)
		end

end
